text: Your bananas show up green… and get locked in a room full of gas.
sayTts: [mischievously] Your bananas show up green... and get locked in a room full of gas.

text: Relax: it's how they turn yellow.
sayTts: [playfully] Relax: it's how they turn yellow.

text: A ship at 13 degrees, a sealed room, an invisible gas… and a trick for your kitchen.
say: A ship at thirteen degrees Celsius, a sealed room, an invisible gas… and a trick for your kitchen.
sayTts: [curious] A ship at thirteen degrees Celsius, a sealed room, an invisible gas... and a trick for your kitchen.

text: They're picked green and cross the ocean at about 13 degrees.
say: They're picked green and cross the ocean at about thirteen degrees.
sayTts: [thoughtful] They're picked green and cross the ocean at about thirteen degrees.

text: Not one lower: below that, the peel turns grey and they won't ripen right.
sayTts: [dramatic] Not one lower: below that, the peel turns grey... and they won't ripen right.

text: On arrival, into the ripening room: door shut, ethylene in.
sayTts: [excited] On arrival, into the ripening room: door shut... ethylene in.

text: Just a whiff: 100 to 150 parts per million, for a day or two.
say: Just a whiff: a hundred to a hundred and fifty parts per million, for a day or two.
sayTts: [amazed] Just a whiff: a hundred to a hundred and fifty parts per million... for a day or two.

text: Someone asked: gas on my fruit? Isn't that weird chemistry?
sayTts: [sarcastic] Someone asked: gas on my fruit? Isn't that weird chemistry?

comment.question: Gas on my bananas?? Isn't that weird chemistry? 😬

text: It's the same hormone the banana makes to ripen. They just give it a little nudge.
sayTts: [chuckles] It's the same hormone the banana makes to ripen. They just give it... a little nudge.

text: The kitchen trick: a paper bag, plus one apple.
sayTts: [curious] The kitchen trick: a paper bag... plus one apple.

text: Tag your friend who always eats them green.
sayTts: [excited] Tag your friend who always eats them... green.

text: See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
